==English== {{wp}} ===Etymology=== {{etymon|en|:der|frm:stupide>|tree=1}} {{root|en|ine-pro|*(s)tewp-}} From {{der|en|frm|stupide}}, from {{der|en|la|stupidus||struck senseless, amazed}}, from {{m|la|stupeō||be amazed or confounded, be struck senseless}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*(s)tup-}}, {{m|ine-pro|*(s)tewp-||to push, stick}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*(s)tew-||to push, hit}}. Cognate with {{cog|goh|stubarōn||to be astonished, be stunned, be blocked}}. Related also to {{cog|ang|stoppian||to block, stop}}. More at [[stop]]. ===Pronunciation=== * {{a|en|UK}} ** {{IPA|en|/ˈstjuːpɪd/|a=RP}} ** {{IPA|en|/ˈst͡ʃʉwpɪd/|/ˈʃtjʉw-/|a=SSB}} *** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Xavier hillier-stupid.wav|a=SSB}} ** {{IPA|en|/ˈstjuːpɪt/|a=Northumbria,sometimes}} ** {{IPA|en|/ˈstjʉpɪd/|/ˈst͡ʃʉ-/|a=Scotland}} ** {{IPA|en|/ˈstɪʊpɪd/|a=Wales}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈstupɪd/|/ˈʃtu-/|a=GA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-stupid.ogg|a=US}} ** {{audio|en|En-NYC-stupid.ogg|a=NYC}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈst͡ʃʉːpɪd/|/ˈʃt͡ʃʉː-/|a=AU,NZ}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈsʈ(j)ʊp.ɪɖ/|/ˈsʈ(j)uː.pɪɖ/|a=Indic}} * {{hyph|en|stu|pid}} * {{rhymes|en|uːpɪd|s=2}} ===Adjective=== {{en-adj|er,more}} # Without [[intelligence]]. #: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:stupid}} ## {{q|of animates}} [[lack|Lack]]ing in [[intelligence]]. ##: {{ux|en|It got trapped in the fishing net because it's a big '''stupid''' jellyfish!}} ##* {{quote-song|en|author=w:Taylor Swift|title=Girl at Home|album={{w|Red (Taylor Swift album)|Red}}|year=2012|artist=Taylor Swift|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UNckfN9upqo|text=And it would be a fine proposition
